data.text: DXA scan must be completed at or within 7 days after V2. If rescan is needed and performed outside the 7 days, this will not be a protocol deviation.
AE collection should occur prior to the collection of the C-SSRS. Adapted for the assessment of ideation and behavior categories only.

The daily eDiary will be applicable only to Study Period 1 and ED, if ED occurs in Study Period 1. The daily eDiary for CD includes the following assessments: CDAI Stool Frequency, CDAI Abdominal Pain, CDAI General Well-Being, Bowel Movement Count.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Participant daily diary row

data.text: Site personnel must ensure the participant is trained on daily eDiary completion before the endoscopy visits. Provide additional training as needed. For eDiary compliance requirements, see Section 8.1.2.1 of the IIBD master protocol.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Daily eDiary training row

data.text: Site personnel must fully explain and confirm participant understanding of questionnaire before the device is provided to collect response.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Dispense daily eDiary row

data.text: Participant eDiaries are to be completed daily by the participant at home and reviewed by study personnel. See Section 8.1.2.4 of the IIBD master protocol for more details about the eDiary.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Review daily eDiary row

data.text: At baseline, collect diary from participants who were not eligible for randomization (screen failed).
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Return daily eDiary row

data.text: In addition to the fasting visits for lipids testing, site personnel can make fasting recommendations per local guidelines for the procedures.

data.text: Lipids tested at fasting visits only.
For IOCBP only (see Sections 8.2.6 and 10.4.1 of the IIBD master protocol).

For IOCBP, negative test required prior to dosing at marked visits. In Study Period 1, urine pregnancy tests will be done on site only. Additional pregnancy tests (urine or serum) should be performed at any time during the study if a menstrual period is missed, or there is clinical suspicion of pregnancy, or as required by local law or regulation.
Optional; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB. See Sections 8.2.6 and 10.4.1 of the IIBD master protocol.
Screening includes HBsAg and anti-HBc. If HBsAg is negative and anti-HBc is positive, further testing for HBV DNA is required (Section 8.2.8 of the IIBD master protocol).

data.text: Participants who had a TST will return 48 to 72 hours after placement to have their test results read. PPD test does not need to be read at the site but must be read by a trained medical professional, and the result must be presented to the site personnel prior to participant's randomization (Section 10.7 of the IIBD master protocol).
Collect clinical and laboratory components of CDAI (Section 8.1.2.1 of the IIBD master protocol) and assess participant eligibility at screening before colonoscopy and bowel preparation.
For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2).
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 - Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2

data.text: Participants who received LY/mirikizumab co-administration or mirikizumab in Study Period 1 and who are considered responders at Week 12 of Study Period 1 will receive mirikizumab SC starting at Week 0 of Study Period 2. For definition of responders, see Sections 4.1 and 8.1 of the IIBD master protocol.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 - Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2

data.text: For responders to mirikizumab or LY/mirikizumab co-administration treatment, Visit 6 and Visit 7 will occur on the same day and the Visit 6 procedures are not repeated at Visit 7 (excluding 'Register visit with IWRS').
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 - Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2

data.text: Visit 8 and Visit 10 of the IIBD master protocol SoA do not apply to this ISA.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 - Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2

data.text: V7 will be conducted on same day as V6.

Perform as shown in this schedule and as needed at any visit based on participant status and standard of care. Includes examination of eyes, throat, heart, lungs, abdomen, and visual examination of the skin. May be performed by qualified personnel per local regulations. Assess for TB risk factors and for signs and symptoms of active TB, including an assessment of peripheral lymph nodes.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 2 - Symptom-directed physical assessment row

data.text: For IOCBP, negative test required prior to dosing at marked visits. In Study Period 2, urine pregnancy tests can be done on-site or at home. Optional per investigator's discretion; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB. See Section 8.2.6 and 10.4.1 of the IIBD master protocol.
For participants who are anti-HBc positive at screening (Section 8.2.8 of the IIBD master protocol).
